d: As foreign investors pull a record $31 billion out of Indian stocks, SEBI has reportedly recommended scrapping the 12.5% long-term capital gains tax to attract global money ahead of the February 2027 Budget. Meanwhile, America’s 2026 midterm elections could reshape Donald Trump’s political power and have far-reaching consequences for India, from tariffs and H-1B visas to oil prices, trade and stock markets. Firstpost examines both developments and their potential impact on India and global markets. Hem Saroya tells you more.
